abstract: Large language models (LLMs) show promise in specialty medicine, yet existing evaluations largely focus on isolated clinical encounters rather than tracking how clinical responsibilities evolve across a longitudinal care pathway. Here we introduce NPC-RubricBench, a phase-aware benchmark for evaluating multistage clinical reasoning across the cancer care continuum, using nasopharyngeal carcinoma as a defined disease context. Curated from longitudinal records of 405 patients across two cancer centers, the benchmark comprises 941 patient-phase units across six sequential care phases and 17,688 patient-specific atomic criteria spanning five evaluation dimensions, with each assessment strictly restricted to decision-time clinical evidence. Evaluating 30 general-purpose and medical LLMs revealed that strong diagnostic performance does not carry over to downstream care. We evaluated 30 general-purpose and medical LLMs, showing that high diagnostic performance did not translate into improved downstream care. Instead, the dominant failure modes reversed across phases. Explicit decision errors dominated anatomical staging at 48.2%, whereas decision omissions dominated initial work-up and post-treatment follow-up at 33.4% and 30.4%, respectively. In the evaluated model set, medically adapted models showed higher omission rates than general-purpose models. Moreover, varying query granularity exposes a critical specification trade-off: broad open-ended requests degrade Decision Quality across all 30 models, while more detailed, checklist-like prompts raise Decision Quality but reduce Evidence Faithfulness and Safety Adherence. Furthermore, NPC-RubricBench demonstrates that static diagnostic benchmarks are insufficient to ensure consistent clinical reliability over time, highlighting the importance of phase-adaptive safeguards in multistage medical AI.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在专科医学中显示出前景，但现有评估主要集中于孤立的临床诊疗环节，而非追踪临床职责如何在纵向诊疗路径中演变。在此，我们提出NPC-RubricBench，这是一个具有阶段感知特性的基准，用于评估贯穿癌症诊疗全程的多阶段临床推理，并以鼻咽癌作为限定的疾病背景。该基准整理自两家癌症中心405例患者的纵向记录，包含涵盖六个连续诊疗阶段的941个患者-阶段单元，以及跨越五个评估维度的17,688条患者特异性原子标准，每项评估严格限定于决策时点可获得的临床证据。对30个通用型和医学专用LLM进行评估发现，较强的诊断性能并不能延续到下游诊疗。我们评估了30个通用型和医学专用LLM，结果显示高诊断性能并未转化为更好的下游诊疗。相反，主要失败模式在各阶段间发生了反转。解剖学分期中以明确的决策错误为主，占48.2%；而初始检查和治疗后随访中则以决策遗漏为主，分别占33.4%和30.4%。在所评估的模型集合中，医学适配模型的遗漏率高于通用型模型。此外，改变提问粒度揭示了一个关键的指令设定权衡：宽泛的开放式请求会使全部30个模型的决策质量（Decision Quality）下降，而更详细、类似清单的提示可提高决策质量，但会降低证据忠实性（Evidence Faithfulness）和安全性依从性（Safety Adherence）。此外，NPC-RubricBench表明，静态诊断基准不足以确保长期一致的临床可靠性，凸显了在多阶段医学AI中采用阶段自适应保障措施的重要性。

abstract: [Internal and emergency medicine] Epicardial adipose tissue (EAT) is significantly associated with cardiovascular disease and poor prognosis. Deep learning (DL) models have been explored for automatic EAT segmentation, but systematic evidence verifying their effectiveness is currently lacking. We conducted this meta-analysis to evaluate the accuracy of DL models for EAT segmentation and quantification, aiming to support the development of automated tools. We searched the Cochrane Library, Embase, Web of Science, PubMed, and IEEE Xplore through February 20, 2026. Studies reporting DL-based quantitative EAT segmentation were included. Quality was assessed with QUADAS-2. The Dice similarity coefficient (Dice), correlation coefficient (R), and Bland-Altman bias were used to evaluate segmentation efficacy, the correlation between automated segmentation and reference standards, and consistency, respectively. A random-effects model with the Hartung-Knapp-Sidik-Jonkman method pooled these measures. Thirty eligible studies were included, covering five image types. For non-contrast computed tomography (NCCT), the pooled Dice was 0.888 (95% confidence interval [CI]: 0.853-0.924), and the pooled R reached 0.973 (95%CI: 0.958-0.982). The contrast-enhanced computed tomography (CECT) subgroup performed best, yielding a Dice of 0.910 (95% CI: 0.881-0.939) and an R of 0.989 (95% CI: 0.976-0.995). This meta-analysis quantifies the accuracy of DL models for EAT segmentation and volume quantification. The findings indicate that DL achieves robust accuracy on both NCCT and CECT images. However, given that most current studies rely on internal validation, future work should prioritize large-scale, multicenter external validation to support the translation of these promising DL tools into robust clinical diagnostic systems.

abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is widely used in clinical assessment, brain-computer interfaces, and cognitive-state analysis, yet EEG modeling remains fragmented across task paradigms. Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) provide a promising interface for flexible multimodal reasoning, but their ability to understand EEG inputs remains limited. In this work, we propose OneEEG, a unified EEG-MLLM framework for multi-task EEG understanding. By training on our curated OneEEG-Instruct, a multi-task EEG instruction-tuning dataset, OneEEG jointly models numerical EEG representations and visual EEG representations, and introduces a task-aware Mixture of Projectors (MoP) to align heterogeneous EEG features across different task families with the LLM embedding space. We further establish OneEEG-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating current MLLMs and our method on multi-task EEG understanding. Experiments show that existing MLLMs have limited ability to interpret EEG inputs, while OneEEG achieves stronger performance by integrating numerical and visual EEG representations with task-aware EEG-to-LLM projection. Extensive ablations and analyses further reveal the effects of visual EEG renderings, MoP variants, router behavior, and feature dispersion across EEG tasks.

abstract: Predicting how individual cells respond to perturbations is a central task in artificial intelligence virtual cell (AIVC) modeling. However, integrating perturbation datasets is challenging because they differ in measured gene sets, perturbation types and cellular contexts. Existing AIVC predictors are typically developed for specific settings, limiting their applicability across heterogeneous datasets. Here, we investigate the extent to which AIVC predictors can benefit from unified perturbational modeling (UPM), a novel paradigm designed to integrate heterogeneous Perturb-seq datasets into a single predictive model. To this end, we introduce three unification modules into a variational autoencoder (VAE)-based AIVC predictor to address these sources of heterogeneity: gene-channel alignment, shared perturbation encoding, and joint embedding of gene expression and identity. We systematically evaluate and validate the individual contributions of these modules. Building on UPM, we assemble a dataset of 110 million cells spanning over 22,000 genes, four perturbation types and 76 cellular contexts, and use 89.7 million cells from 71 contexts to train a unified AIVC predictor with more than one billion parameters. Across genetic perturbation benchmarks, UPM achieves the highest PES and gene-wise response correlation among the evaluated models. It also improves all four evaluation metrics over State on the five held-out Tahoe-100M cell lines and over Stack on the cytokine benchmark. UPM also improves combinatorial perturbation prediction relative to specialized predictors. In the HSC application, our model achieves a 40.0% improvement in accuracy on a downstream task involving the recapitulation of effects induced by the knockdown of hepatic stellate cell (HSC)-related targets. Our implementation is openly available at https://github.com/youlab2025/UPM.

abstract: Single-cell proteomics provides a direct functional readout of cellular states, but targeted assays measure limited and non-identical protein panels, fragmenting information across experiments. Here, we present ProtCell, a foundation model developed using approximately 380 million cells from 98 datasets for pretraining and evaluation. ProtCell combines protein-identity and continuous-abundance embeddings in a transformer encoder and learns cell- and protein-level representations through masked abundance modeling. ProtCell first connects fragmented profiles through transferable annotation and batch correction while preserving biological organization. It then extends limited profiles through abundance reconstruction and inference of an unmeasured cytotoxic protein program enriched in natural killer cells and memory CD8$^+$ T cells. The learned protein dependencies further guide the selection of compact panels that retain information for profile reconstruction and biological classification. ProtCell thus provides a framework for connecting fragmented proteomic profiles, extending information beyond measured panels and guiding more informative measurements.

abstract: [Acta medica Okayama] Peroral cholangioscopy (POCS) enables direct intraductal visualization and targeted biopsies for indeterminate biliary strictures. However, its diagnostic performance remains operator-dependent and is limited by sampling error. As artificial intelligence (AI) has rapidly advanced in gastrointestinal endoscopy, AI-assisted cholangioscopy has progressed from proof-of-concept image classification to multicenter validation, feature detection, and real-time application. Recent studies using digital single-operator cholangioscopy have reported diagnostic accuracy comparable to that of experts in differentiating malignant from benign strictures, and feature-based approaches can automatically detect tumor vessels and other key visual characteristics. Beyond classification, generative models may enhance mucosal and margin visualization through virtual chromoendoscopy, potentially improving lesion-margin assessment. Furthermore, new models compatible with multiple systems are emerging to address device heterogeneity, which is a key barrier to routine practice. This review summarizes the current evidence on AI-assisted POCS, discusses practical considerations for clinical translation, and highlights future directions, including real-time integration and multimodal decision support.

abstract: [Advanced science (Weinheim, Baden-Wurttemberg, Germany)] The translation of nanomedicines is frequently bottlenecked by trial-and-error optimization. Integrating artificial intelligence (AI) transforms this process into a closed-loop, experimentally grounded discovery ecosystem. This Review provides a roadmap for this paradigm, demonstrating how AI, high-throughput testing, and nanoscale design converge to generate clinically translatable nanotherapeutics. We emphasize the necessity of standardized multimodal data-spanning pharmacokinetic, biodistribution, and drug-release profiles-anchored strictly to validated biological phenomena. Furthermore, we evaluate an algorithmic spectrum, ranging from classical machine learning to physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) and reinforcement learning (RL), to align models with specific formulation objectives. To bridge computational design and empirical reality, we examine how high-throughput technologies, such as robotic laboratories and in vivo DNA-barcoding multiplexing, operationalize the "Design-Make-Test-Analyze" (DMTA) cycle for dynamic model recalibration. Ultimately, this review demonstrates how integrating AI, physical constraints, and automated validation accelerates the rational design of next-generation nanomedicines.

层次状态空间模型刻画叙事时间演化
初步结果显示二分类风险预测有提升
reason: 预印本，MIMIC单库弱监督，但契合心理健康与纵向建模偏好
abstract: Mental-health risks such as depression, dementia, and suicidal ideation can emerge during hospitalization among chronically ill patients and may worsen without timely recognition and intervention. However, most existing mental health studies focus on patients with established psychiatric conditions rather than patients hospitalized primarily for physical illness. In this work, we investigate whether latent mental-health risk in chronically ill patients can be inferred from longitudinal clinical narratives. We construct a weakly supervised cohort around 4,000 patients from MIMIC-III using mental-health evidence extracted from discharge summaries. A hierarchical state-space framework derives mental-health representations from day-wise clinical narratives and models their temporal evolution for risk estimation throughout hospitalization. Preliminary results demonstrate improved binary risk prediction using the proposed representations and show distinct model derived risk trajectories between risk and no-risk cohorts, providing a foundation for studying emerging mental-health risks in chronically ill patients.
zh_abstract: 抑郁、痴呆和自杀意念等心理健康风险可在慢性病患者住院期间出现，若未及时识别和干预可能加重。然而，现有大多数心理健康研究关注的是已确诊精神疾病的患者，而非主要因躯体疾病住院的患者。在本研究中，我们探讨能否从纵向临床叙述文本中推断慢性病患者潜在的心理健康风险。我们利用从出院小结中提取的心理健康证据，基于 MIMIC-III 构建了一个约 4,000 名患者的弱监督队列。一个分层状态空间框架从逐日临床叙述中提取心理健康表征，并对其时间演变进行建模，以估计整个住院期间的风险。初步结果表明，使用所提出的表征可改善二分类风险预测，并显示出有风险与无风险队列之间由模型推导的风险轨迹存在明显差异，为研究慢性病患者新出现的心理健康风险奠定了基础。

title: Can JEV Support Clinical Trial Criteria Assessment?
zh_title: JEV能否支持临床试验入排标准评估？
summary: 回顾性比较非生成式决策模型JEV与Qwen Flash在2048个患者-条件对上的试验预筛表现，批量模式下多数数据集macro-F1相近，MIMIC-III上JEV更高。
key_points: 数据来自TrialGPT及MIMIC-III/IV衍生问答集
TrialGPT与MIMIC-IV上两者macro-F1相近
MIMIC-III上JEV为0.768，Qwen为0.534
reason: 试验匹配方向有新意，预印本，回顾性且证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Clinical trial prescreening requires distinguishing unmet conditions from insufficient evidence in patient records. Given patient records, criterion questions, and predefined answer options, we retrospectively compared JEV, a non-generative decision model returning native option probabilities, with schema-constrained Qwen Flash across 2,048 test patient-condition pairs from TrialGPT and question-answer datasets derived from MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV, all evaluated under strict Zero Data Retention (ZDR) policies to ensure clinical data privacy. Both models assessed conditions individually or in batches sharing the same patient context, with performance measured against reference labels. In batch mode, JEV and Qwen achieved similar macro-F1 scores on TrialGPT (0.652 vs. 0.660) and MIMIC-IV (0.807 vs. 0.814), whereas JEV substantially outperformed Qwen on MIMIC-III (0.768 vs. 0.534; $Δ$ = +0.234, 95% CI: 0.187-0.281). This advantage largely reflected higher recall for conditions labeled as having insufficient information (56.3% vs. 9.9%). Across all three datasets, JEV also had lower observed median job latency (1.18-1.40 vs. 2.80-8.90 s) and 53%-74% lower estimated cost per condition. These findings position JEV as an initial assessment component that provides criterion-level judgments and flags potential information gaps for review. JEV's observed errors in interpreting clinical evidence underscore the need to verify its outputs against patient records before they inform eligibility decisions.
zh_abstract: 临床试验预筛选需要在患者病历中区分未满足的条件与证据不足的情况。给定患者病历、标准问题和预先设定的答案选项，我们回顾性比较了JEV（一种返回原生选项概率的非生成式决策模型）与受模式约束的Qwen Flash，比较基于来自TrialGPT以及源自MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV的问答数据集的2,048个测试用患者-条件对；所有评估均在严格的零数据留存（ZDR）政策下进行，以确保临床数据隐私。两种模型均对条件逐一评估，或在共享相同患者背景的情况下分批评估，并以参考标签衡量性能。在批量模式下，JEV与Qwen在TrialGPT（0.652 vs. 0.660）和MIMIC-IV（0.807 vs. 0.814）上取得了相近的宏平均F1分数，而在MIMIC-III上JEV显著优于Qwen（0.768 vs. 0.534；$Δ$ = +0.234，95% CI：0.187-0.281）。这一优势主要体现在对标注为信息不足的条件具有更高的召回率（56.3% vs. 9.9%）。在全部三个数据集中，JEV观察到的任务延迟中位数也更低（1.18-1.40 vs. 2.80-8.90秒），每个条件的估计成本低53%-74%。这些发现表明，JEV可作为初步评估组件，提供标准层面的判断，并标记潜在的信息缺口以供复核。JEV在解读临床证据时观察到的错误，凸显了在其输出结果用于入选资格决策之前，需对照患者病历进行核实。

title: Artificial Intelligence-Driven Nanobody Engineering for Pathogen Recognition: From Functional Epitope Prioritization to Multimodal Foundation Models.
zh_title: AI驱动的纳米抗体工程：从功能表位到多模态基础模型
summary: 综述 AI 在病原体靶向纳米抗体（VHH）设计中的作用，围绕结构-功能-转化链条，涵盖表位优先级、从头设计及多模态基础模型。

覆盖结构基础、数据资源与从头设计

abstract: [Biomolecules] Nanobodies are compact and stable proteins derived from the variable domain of camelid heavy-chain-only antibodies (VHH). Advances in structural biology, molecular modeling, and artificial intelligence (AI) are shifting VHH discovery from empirical selection toward data-driven design. However, predicted binding alone does not ensure biological activity or successful translation, particularly for antigenically variable pathogens. Complementing recent reviews that broadly survey computational VHH modeling and optimization, this review focuses on how antigen biology and functional epitope prioritization can guide the design of pathogen-targeting VHHs. We organize the field along a structure-function-translation continuum, connecting the structural basis of VHH recognition and available data resources with conventional discovery, antigen-guided de novo design, and sequence-structure learning. We further examine how developability, recombinant production, multispecificity, humanization, structural dynamics, and antigenic variation shape the progression from predicted binders to functional VHHs. Finally, we discuss how multimodal foundation models could integrate these dimensions to support the design of functional, manufacturable, and escape-resilient VHHs.

title: From Isolated Intelligence to Interpretive Infrastructure in Radiology AI.
source: PubMed · The British journal of radiology
zh_title: 从孤立智能到解释性基础设施：放射学AI的架构反思
summary: 观点文章指出放射学AI获批工具多但临床影响不稳定，认为瓶颈在架构而非算法，提出基于临床框架的混合编排层。
key_points: 放射学获批AI工具最多，但临床影响不及基准表现
认为问题在于缺乏时间、情境与经验整合及反事实信号
提出基于既有临床框架的混合编排层
reason: 观点类文章，无新数据验证，属常规观点档
abstract: [The British journal of radiology] Radiology has more regulatory-cleared artificial intelligence tools than any other medical specialty, yet they have delivered less consistent clinical impact than their benchmark performance suggested. We argue that the dominant response, scaling perceptual models and extending them toward autonomous agency, mistakes the nature of the problem. The limitation is architectural, not algorithmic: current systems perform isolated perception while remaining disconnected from the temporal, contextual, and experiential integration that interpretation requires. We trace this to a fundamental simulation gap, the absence of the counterfactual signal that lets AI reach superhuman performance in other domains, and argue that scaling alone cannot close it. In response, we outline a hybrid orchestration layer, grounded in established clinical frameworks, that assembles a comprehensive evidence base for the radiologist while keeping generative components constrained and interpretive judgment human. The shift is one of design paradigm: from isolated tools deployed alongside the radiologist to interpretive infrastructure that composes validated outputs into coherent evidence without anchoring the reader's own assessment.

title: Evaluating Bayesian deep learning for robust biomedical time-series classification under distribution shift: A sleep scoring case study
zh_title: 分布偏移下贝叶斯深度学习的生物医学时序分类：睡眠评分案例
summary: 以啮齿类睡眠评分为例，比较九种近似推断方法，评估贝叶斯模型平均在基因型、实验室、物种偏移下的稳健性。
key_points: 比较九种近似推断与两种骨干网络

reason: 预印本，有系统基线对比和多个OOD数据集，但为动物睡眠数据
abstract: In biomedical time-series classification, machine learning models often suffer from deteriorating accuracy and calibration due to distribution shift. We investigate to what degree Bayesian-inspired deep learning improves robustness through Bayesian model averaging (BMA). Using rodent sleep scoring as a case study, we evaluate BMA under distribution shifts in genotype, laboratory, and species. We systematically compare nine approximate inference methods spanning single- and multi-basin approaches across two neural network backbones on in-distribution (ID) data and five out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets. In our results, multi-basin methods perform best, outperforming baselines and single-basin methods. Compared with point estimates, BMA generally improves OOD accuracy and calibration across both architectures, while yielding only modest ID gains. It also often improves selective prediction and OOD and artifact detection, but, interestingly, not inter-rater disagreement detection.
zh_abstract: 在生物医学时间序列分类中，机器学习模型常因分布偏移而出现准确性和校准性下降。我们研究了受贝叶斯启发的深度学习通过贝叶斯模型平均（BMA）在多大程度上提高鲁棒性。以啮齿动物睡眠评分为案例，我们在基因型、实验室和物种的分布偏移下评估 BMA。我们在分布内（ID）数据和五个分布外（OOD）数据集上，针对两种神经网络骨干，系统比较了涵盖单盆地和多盆地方法的九种近似推断方法。结果显示，多盆地方法表现最佳，优于基线方法和单盆地方法。与点估计相比，BMA 在两种架构上总体上提高了 OOD 准确性和校准性，而 ID 方面仅有适度提升。BMA 还常常改善选择性预测以及 OOD 和伪迹检测，但有趣的是，并未改善评分者间分歧的检测。

title: Targeted Deep Regression - Initial Applications in Whole-Body Water-Fat MRI in UK Biobank
zh_title: 靶向深度回归：UK Biobank全身水脂MRI的初步应用
summary: 提出基于ResNet50的图像回归方法，将参考扫描中定义的解剖子区域传播到3万余例颈-膝水脂MRI，估计数值型影像表型。
key_points: ResNet50处理多通道子区域拼图
手动子区域经配准传播到>30,000例扫描
用于扩展UK Biobank影像衍生表型
reason: 大规模队列预印本，方法常规，摘要无外部验证
abstract: UK Biobank is a British clinical study which, in addition to large amounts of medical data collected, plans to include detailed Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) examina- tions from 100,000 participants. The image data can be analyzed for example by auto- mated analysis with neural networks for image segmentation or classification to expand the collection of image-derived phenotypes for medical research. In this work, we pro- pose, present and evaluate a methodology that uses image-based regression to estimate numerical properties from the collected neck-to-knee water-fat MRI scans. It applies a ResNet50-style network to 2D multi-channel collages that represent targeted and study- specific anatomical sub-regions from the MRI scan. The targeted sub-region sampling is achieved by propagating manually defined subregions from a reference scan to the other >30,000 analyzed scans using image registration. The resulting collages can be compact while retaining high-resolution, for example by providing multiple slices of kidney tissue for a kidney volume regression network. This approach also enables group-wise saliency analysis that highlight image and anatomical regions used by the network for the pre- dictions. The method was applied for the regression endpoints of kidney volume, heart volume, and age. Predictive performance was found between R2 = 0.731-0.984 and the group-wise saliency maps were found to highlight medically relevant regions. We con- clude that the method can be used to standardize and restrict the information presented to a deep regression analysis pipeline, increasing information density and opening up a wide range of future medical inference studies.

title: Domain-Adapted Latent Diffusion Models for CT-to-PET Image Translation
zh_title: 用于CT到PET图像转换的域适应潜在扩散模型
summary: 提出域适应潜在扩散框架，用21,930对CT/PET切片迁移自然图像先验，在重建和肿瘤保真度上优于CPDM基线。
key_points: 迁移自然图像先验缓解配对数据稀缺
采用符号幂变换处理PET强度稀疏
与最先进基线CPDM对比表现更优
reason: 有基线对比的新方法预印本，证据有限
abstract: Positron Emission Tomography (PET) provides important metabolic information for tumor detection and staging but remains significantly less accessible than Computed Tomography (CT) due to its high cost, infrastructure requirements, and reliance on injected radioactive tracers. CT-to-PET image translation using generative models aims to address this disparity, yet state-of-the-art diffusion-based methods are limited by the scarcity of paired training data. To overcome this, we propose a domain-adapted latent diffusion framework that transfers natural-image priors using a relatively small dataset of 21,930 paired CT/PET slices, incorporating a signed power transform to resolve extreme intensity sparsity in PET data. Compared to CPDM, a state-ofthe-art baseline for CT-to-PET image translation, our approach yields superior performance in pixel-wise reconstruction and localized tumor fidelity, demonstrating effective transfer of natural-image priors to the medical domain. We further provide a systematic analysis of evaluation metric reliability for sparse PET data, showing that standard full-image metrics can be misleading indicators of translated image quality, and propose background-filtered and mask-restricted metrics as more clinically meaningful alternatives.
zh_abstract: 正电子发射断层扫描（PET）为肿瘤检测和分期提供重要的代谢信息，但由于成本高、基础设施要求高以及依赖注射放射性示踪剂，其可及性仍明显低于计算机断层扫描（CT）。利用生成模型进行CT到PET的图像转换旨在缓解这一差距，然而最先进的基于扩散的方法受限于配对训练数据的稀缺。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种领域适应的潜在扩散框架，利用包含21,930对CT/PET切片的相对较小的数据集迁移自然图像先验，并引入带符号幂变换以解决PET数据中极端的强度稀疏问题。与CT到PET图像转换的最先进基线CPDM相比，我们的方法在逐像素重建和局部肿瘤保真度方面表现更优，证明了自然图像先验可有效迁移至医学领域。我们还对稀疏PET数据评价指标的可靠性进行了系统分析，表明标准的全图指标可能会误导对转换图像质量的判断，并提出经背景过滤和掩膜限定的指标作为更具临床意义的替代方案。

title: TransECG-SSL: Hybrid Self-Supervised Representation Learning for ECG Arrhythmia Classification
zh_title: TransECG-SSL：用于心律失常分类的混合自监督表征学习
summary: 提出结合掩码重建与对比学习的Transformer自监督框架，在三个公开ECG数据库的七种源-目标设置下做线性探测评估。
key_points: Transformer编码器用混合目标预训练后冻结
按患者划分，跨三个公开数据库评估
优于随机初始化Transformer，平衡准确率更高
reason: 预印本，有跨数据集评估但仅公开数据，属值得一看档
abstract: Cross-dataset generalisation remains a major challenge for automated electrocardiogram (ECG) arrhythmia classification because of differences in patient populations, acquisition protocols, annotation practices, and class distributions. Learning representations that remain informative across independent datasets could reduce reliance on dataset-specific labelled data. We propose TransECG-SSL, a self-supervised framework for transferable heartbeat representation learning from unlabelled ECG data. A Transformer encoder is pretrained using a hybrid objective combining masked signal reconstruction and contrastive learning, then frozen and evaluated by linear probing under patient-disjoint evaluation. Experiments across three public ECG databases and seven source--target settings show that Hybrid SSL consistently outperforms randomly initialised Transformers and achieves higher balanced accuracy than architecture-matched source-supervised pretraining. Reconstruction-only SSL remains competitive with Hybrid SSL, whereas contrastive-only pretraining performs substantially worse, highlighting the importance of masked reconstruction for transferability. Cross-dataset transfer nevertheless reduces balanced accuracy relative to target-specific self-supervised pretraining, while minority arrhythmia classes remain challenging under severe class imbalance. These findings demonstrate the potential of label-efficient self-supervised learning for cross-dataset ECG representation transfer while highlighting persistent limitations from domain shift and class imbalance.
zh_abstract: 由于患者群体、采集方案、标注实践和类别分布的差异，跨数据集泛化仍是心电图（ECG）心律失常自动分类的一大挑战。学习在独立数据集之间仍具信息量的表征，可减少对特定数据集标注数据的依赖。我们提出TransECG-SSL，一个从未标注ECG数据中学习可迁移心搏表征的自监督框架。Transformer编码器采用结合掩码信号重建与对比学习的混合目标进行预训练，随后冻结，并在患者不重叠的评估下通过线性探测进行评价。在三个公共ECG数据库和七种源—目标设置下的实验表明，混合自监督学习（Hybrid SSL）始终优于随机初始化的Transformer，并且比结构匹配的源域监督预训练取得更高的平衡准确率。仅重建的自监督学习与混合自监督学习相比仍具竞争力，而仅对比学习的预训练表现明显更差，突显了掩码重建对可迁移性的重要性。然而，与针对目标域的自监督预训练相比，跨数据集迁移会降低平衡准确率，同时在严重类别不平衡下少数类心律失常仍具挑战性。这些发现表明，标签高效的自监督学习在跨数据集ECG表征迁移方面具有潜力，同时也凸显了领域偏移和类别不平衡带来的持续局限。

title: Synthetic Deformable Tubular Benchmark: A mechanically annotated dataset for evaluating deformable 3D reconstruction
zh_title: 合成可变形管状基准：带力学标注的可变形3D重建数据集
summary: 发布含5,580张RGB图像的合成管状场景基准及开源工具LumenMorph，提供相机位姿、深度、形变场与材料对应等标注。
key_points: 含5,580张RGB图像，涵盖六类场景
提供位姿、几何、深度、形变场及有限元记录
配套开源工具包LumenMorph
reason: 新基准且开源，但为合成数据，医疗关联间接
abstract: Evaluating deformable 3D reconstruction requires ground truth linking camera motion, surface deformation, material correspondence and image appearance. We introduce the Synthetic Deformable Tubular Benchmark, generated with LumenMorph, an open-source toolkit for creating, annotating and evaluating tubular scenes. The release contains 5,580 RGB images. Its baseline crosses three surface-motion conditions with moving and stationary cameras in six scene families; matched appearance variants cover only moving-camera finite-element actions in four families. Documented public and evaluation interfaces expose camera poses, geometry, depth, deformation fields, persistent material correspondences and discrete finite-element records. Persistent triangle identities and material weights let users track the same surface location across frames and query its three-dimensional trajectory. Separately implemented geometric and mechanical checks assess annotation consistency with the generating models. Structure-from-motion, optical-flow and supplied-geometry displacement-interpolation studies demonstrate how the resource distinguishes registration coverage from geometric accuracy, exposes camera- and surface-motion effects, and tests the benefits and mismatch of mechanical priors. Public readers, evaluation contracts and the configurable generator support reuse and extension. Data integrity, fixed-environment repeatability and retained-prediction score replay have distinct verification scopes. The benchmark provides a controlled synthetic reference without claiming anatomical or clinical realism.
zh_abstract: 评估可变形三维重建需要将相机运动、表面形变、材料对应关系和图像外观相联系的真值。我们提出了合成可变形管状基准（Synthetic Deformable Tubular Benchmark），该基准由LumenMorph生成，LumenMorph是一个用于创建、标注和评估管状场景的开源工具包。本次发布包含5,580张RGB图像。其基线在六个场景族中将三种表面运动条件与移动相机和静止相机交叉组合；匹配的外观变体仅涵盖四个场景族中移动相机的有限元动作。文档完备的公共接口和评估接口提供相机位姿、几何、深度、形变场、持久的材料对应关系以及离散的有限元记录。持久的三角形标识和材料权重使用户能够跨帧追踪同一表面位置并查询其三维轨迹。独立实现的几何与力学检查用于评估标注与生成模型之间的一致性。运动恢复结构（structure-from-motion）、光流以及基于所提供几何的位移插值研究表明，该资源能够区分配准覆盖率与几何精度，揭示相机运动和表面运动的影响，并检验力学先验的益处及其失配情况。公共读取器、评估约定和可配置的生成器支持复用与扩展。数据完整性、固定环境下的可重复性以及基于保留预测的评分重放具有各自不同的验证范围。该基准提供了受控的合成参照，但不声称具有解剖学或临床真实性。

存在领域敏感性与标签解释漂移

abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for codebook-based content analysis in computational social science, where codebooks translate theoretical concepts into labeling schemes. While prior work reports strong predictive performance, it remains unclear whether these systems produce reliable and robust text annotations. We conduct a large-scale empirical failure-mode analysis of LLM-based coding pipelines across four datasets and five models by systematically evaluating their stability, robustness, and conceptual validity under controlled perturbations, domain shifts, and optimization procedures. We uncover multiple failure modes that are largely invisible under standard metrics, showing that high aggregate scores frequently coexist with severe label-level disparities, instability across runs, domain sensitivity, and shifts in label interpretation. Importantly, these failure modes persist under widely used optimization strategies and remain largely invisible under standard metrics such as accuracy and micro-F1. Our results demonstrate that current LLM-based coding pipelines cannot be treated as stable measurement tools without targeted validation beyond aggregate performance.
zh_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地用于计算社会科学中基于编码手册的内容分析，其中编码手册将理论概念转化为标注方案。尽管既往研究报告了较强的预测性能，但这些系统能否产生可靠且稳健的文本标注仍不明确。我们针对基于LLM的编码流程开展了大规模实证失效模式分析，涉及四个数据集和五个模型，在受控扰动、领域迁移和优化流程下系统评估其稳定性、稳健性和概念效度。我们发现了多种在标准指标下基本不可见的失效模式，表明较高的总体得分常常与严重的标签层面差异、多次运行间的不稳定性、领域敏感性以及标签解释的偏移同时存在。重要的是，这些失效模式在广泛使用的优化策略下依然存在，并且在准确率和micro-F1等标准指标下基本不可见。我们的结果表明，若不进行超越总体性能的针对性验证，当前基于LLM的编码流程不能被视为稳定的测量工具。

title: SAP-ViT: A Self-Attributing Patch Vision Transformer for Medical Image Classification
zh_title: SAP-ViT：用于医学图像分类的自归因补丁视觉Transformer
summary: 提出SAP-ViT，以末层补丁嵌入直接聚合替代CLS token，使预测可分解为补丁级贡献，并加稀疏正则；在多个医学图像分类数据集上评估。
key_points: 用补丁嵌入聚合取代CLS token分类
对补丁权重施加稀疏正则以获得简洁证据
引入输入空间回映射估计输入补丁贡献
reason: 有新意的可解释ViT方法预印本，证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Vision Transformer (ViT) classifiers commonly rely on a global classification (CLS) token for image-level prediction, which is poorly aligned with local interpretability requirements in medical imaging. We propose SAP-ViT, a Self-Attributing Patch Vision Transformer that replaces CLS-based classification with direct aggregation of last-layer patch embeddings. This design makes class predictions decomposable into patch-level contributions as part of the forward pass. To encourage concise and readable evidence, SAP-ViT applies sparsity regularization to the patch-weight distribution. Since self-attention mixes information across patch tokens, we further introduce an input-space back-mapping mechanism to estimate which input patches contribute to influential output patch embeddings. We evaluate SAP-ViT qualitatively and quantitatively on multiple medical image classification datasets spanning different imaging modalities. The results show that SAP-ViT maintains strong classification performance while providing consistent and interpretable patch-level explanations across datasets. Ablation results further show that both sparsity regularization and the alignment component of input-space back-mapping contribute to the final explanation quality. Overall, SAP-ViT provides a favorable trade-off between predictive accuracy and interpretability for ViT-based medical image classification.
zh_abstract: 视觉Transformer（ViT）分类器通常依赖全局分类（CLS）token进行图像级预测，这与医学影像中对局部可解释性的要求不相符。我们提出SAP-ViT（自归因补丁视觉Transformer），其以对最后一层补丁嵌入的直接聚合取代基于CLS的分类。该设计使类别预测在前向传播过程中即可分解为补丁级贡献。为获得简洁易读的证据，SAP-ViT对补丁权重分布施加稀疏性正则化。由于自注意力会在补丁token之间混合信息，我们进一步引入输入空间回映射机制，以估计哪些输入补丁对具有影响力的输出补丁嵌入有贡献。我们在涵盖不同成像模态的多个医学图像分类数据集上对SAP-ViT进行了定性和定量评估。结果显示，SAP-ViT在保持较强分类性能的同时，能够在各数据集上提供一致且可解释的补丁级解释。消融结果进一步表明，稀疏性正则化和输入空间回映射的对齐部分均有助于提升最终解释质量。总体而言，SAP-ViT在基于ViT的医学图像分类中，在预测准确性与可解释性之间实现了良好的权衡。

title: EXCISE: Locating and Excising Distracting Sentences in Medical Question Answering
zh_title: EXCISE：定位并剔除医学问答中的干扰句
summary: 预印本提出推理时方法EXCISE，通过阻断对干扰句的注意力，减弱无关句对医学问答模型答案的影响。
key_points: 阻断已知干扰句注意力可恢复答案，而头屏蔽可能抑制正确答案
隐藏状态可将干扰句标为最不契合病例的句子
EXCISE仅在隐藏状态判定不一致时阻断最具影响的句子
reason: 预印本新方法有机制分析，但摘要截断、证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Language models are increasingly considered for clinical decision support, where their answers should be grounded in clinical evidence and remain robust to irrelevant information. Prior work shows that a single irrelevant sentence can lower the accuracy of medical models, but not where inside the model its effect can be removed, or how to do so without knowing which sentence it is. We find that blocking attention to a known distractor restores the answer, whereas head masking can suppress correct answers. We also show that the model's hidden states mark the distractor as the sentence that least fits the case even when the model follows it. To remove a distractor's effect without knowing which sentence it is, we propose EXCISE, an inference-time method that blocks the sentence most influencing the answer, but only if the model's hidden states mark it as inconsistent with the case. On MedQA-TD (MedQA with Targeted Distractors), a benchmark we construct in which each distractor targets a specific wrong option, EXCISE gains 16.7-22.8 accuracy points at a 1.5-2.1-point cost on the same questions without distractors, outperforming prompting, rewriting, and steering baselines for all three models. Its gains extend to MedDistractQA and BiasMedQA, as well as chain-of-thought generation.
zh_abstract: 语言模型越来越多地被考虑用于临床决策支持，在这类场景中，其回答应当以临床证据为依据，并且对无关信息保持稳健。既往研究表明，仅一句无关的句子就可能降低医学模型的准确率，但尚不清楚其影响可以在模型内部的何处被消除，也不清楚在不知道是哪一句的情况下如何消除。我们发现，阻断对已知干扰句的注意力可以恢复答案，而注意力头屏蔽（head masking）则可能抑制正确答案。我们还表明，即使模型遵循了干扰句，其隐藏状态仍会将该干扰句标记为与病例最不相符的句子。为了在不知道干扰句是哪一句的情况下消除其影响，我们提出了 EXCISE，一种推理阶段的方法：它会阻断对答案影响最大的句子，但仅当模型的隐藏状态将该句标记为与病例不一致时才执行。在我们构建的 MedQA-TD（MedQA with Targeted Distractors，带靶向干扰的 MedQA）基准上（其中每条干扰句都针对一个特定的错误选项），EXCISE 使准确率提高了 16.7–22.8 个百分点，而在相同的无干扰问题上仅损失 1.5–2.1 个百分点，在全部三个模型上均优于提示（prompting）、改写（rewriting）和引导（steering）基线方法。其增益也可推广到 MedDistractQA 和 BiasMedQA，以及思维链（chain-of-thought）生成。

title: Xenograft supervision and joint methylation-fragment-end encoding define a reusable molecular scoring layer for cell-free tumor DNA
zh_title: ctDNA-BERT：异种移植监督与甲基化-片段末端联合编码的游离肿瘤DNA评分层
summary: 提出Transformer模型ctDNA-BERT，联合编码CpG甲基化、核苷酸上下文与片段3'端，对单条亚硫酸氢盐测序读段评分，用于游离肿瘤DNA分析。
key_points: 以异种移植提供分子水平肿瘤监督
冻结模型在独立肝癌与III期泛癌血浆中无需重训
在1,477份回顾性样本中区分I期癌症与健康对照
reason: 新方法含独立队列验证，但为回顾性预印本
abstract: Circulating tumor DNA is often scarce in plasma, and regional methylation summaries can obscure informative differences between individual molecules. Here we present ctDNA-BERT, a Transformer that scores individual bisulfite reads without predefined differentially methylated regions by jointly encoding CpG methylation state, nucleotide context and the fragment 3' end. Xenografts provide molecule-level tumor supervision. The resulting frozen scorer supported tumor-fraction estimation in synthetic and patient-derived xenograft mixtures and enriched tumor-concordant methylation and chromatin-accessibility signals in independent hepatocellular carcinoma and stage III pan-cancer plasma without cohort-specific retraining. Features derived from selected reads discriminated stage I cancers from healthy controls in a retrospective cohort of 1,477 specimens, achieving an out-of-fold area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.884. By separating molecular scoring from sample-level inference, ctDNA-BERT provides a reusable read-level scoring layer for cell-free DNA methylation analysis.
zh_abstract: 循环肿瘤 DNA 在血浆中往往含量稀少，而区域性甲基化汇总可能掩盖单个分子之间的信息性差异。在此我们提出 ctDNA-BERT，这是一种 Transformer 模型，通过联合编码 CpG 甲基化状态、核苷酸背景和片段 3′ 端，在无需预先定义差异甲基化区域的情况下对单条亚硫酸氢盐测序读段进行评分。异种移植模型提供了分子水平的肿瘤监督信号。由此得到的冻结评分器支持在合成混合样本和患者来源异种移植混合样本中估计肿瘤分数，并且无需针对特定队列重新训练，即可在独立的肝细胞癌血浆和 III 期泛癌种血浆中富集与肿瘤一致的甲基化和染色质可及性信号。在一项包含 1,477 份样本的回顾性队列中，由所选读段衍生的特征可区分 I 期癌症与健康对照，折外（out-of-fold）受试者工作特征曲线下面积为 0.884。通过将分子评分与样本水平推断分离，ctDNA-BERT 为游离 DNA 甲基化分析提供了一个可重复使用的读段水平评分层。

title: Asking the Data: Conversational Interrogation of LC-MS/MS Proteomics Data Sets with an LLM Agent
zh_title: 向数据提问：用LLM智能体对LC-MS/MS蛋白质组数据集进行对话式审查
summary: 提出数据集审查框架，研究者通过LLM智能体将问题转为可执行检验并留存记录；回顾性应用于四个数据集，发现影响三项自有研究解读的问题。
key_points: 对话式LLM智能体生成可执行检验并对照控制
记录代码、输入与决策
发现数据库缺失、TMT通道互换等问题
reason: 预印本，智能体用于生物医学发现，仅四个数据集回顾性应用
abstract: Proteomics workflows are designed to answer predefined questions, leaving analytical problems that emerge after first results difficult to investigate without additional bioinformatics work. We introduce data set interrogation, a conversational framework in which a researcher uses a large language model (LLM) agent to translate emerging questions into executable tests, check the answers against controls, and keep the code, inputs, and decisions in a dated record. Applied retrospectively to four LC-MS/MS data sets, the framework exposed problems that changed the interpretation of three in-house studies: a search database lacking one of two symbionts, a swapped pair of tandem mass tag (TMT) channels, statistics inflated by non-host proteins, and false deamidation assignments caused by selection of the 13C isotope peak as monoisotopic; the same question asked of every data set revealed failed or partial cysteine alkylation in all three. A public TMT data set was reanalyzed from raw files in 24 min, a feasibility measure without a human comparison; among spectra identified by both workflows, 99.2% received the same peptide assignment as in Proteome Discoverer, and protein fold changes correlated (r = 0.93). In seeded tests, a purpose built channel assignment check detected all 216 between strain channel swaps and none of 90 within-strain swaps. The framework couples natural language interaction with executable analyses, explicit controls, and traceable decisions, enabling researchers to investigate questions not anticipated by the original pipeline. These results establish feasibility in a limited retrospective setting with one researcher; broader evaluation across users, models, and data sets is required to determine general performance.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质组学工作流程旨在回答预先设定的问题，因此在首批结果出来之后才出现的分析问题，若无额外的生物信息学工作则难以研究。我们提出了数据集质询（data set interrogation），这是一种对话式框架：研究者借助大语言模型（LLM）智能体将新出现的问题转化为可执行的检验，对照对照组核查答案，并将代码、输入和决策保存在带日期的记录中。将该框架回顾性应用于四个LC-MS/MS数据集后，揭示了改变三项内部研究解读的问题：搜索数据库缺少两种共生体之一、串联质谱标签（TMT）的一对通道被调换、非宿主蛋白导致统计量虚高，以及因选择13C同位素峰作为单同位素峰而造成的错误脱酰胺归属；对每个数据集提出同一问题后，发现三者均存在半胱氨酸烷基化失败或不完全。一个公开的TMT数据集从原始文件重新分析仅用24分钟，这是一项没有人工对照的可行性指标；在两种工作流程均鉴定到的谱图中，99.2%获得了与Proteome Discoverer相同的肽段归属，蛋白质倍数变化具有相关性（r = 0.93）。在植入式测试中，专门构建的通道归属检查检出了全部216个菌株间通道调换，而90个菌株内调换均未被检出。该框架将自然语言交互与可执行分析、明确的对照和可追溯的决策相结合，使研究者能够研究原有流程未预料到的问题。这些结果确立了其在有限的、由一名研究者进行的回顾性情境中的可行性；要确定其总体性能，仍需在不同用户、模型和数据集上进行更广泛的评估。

title: Artificial intelligence in modern medicine: a comprehensive review of technologies, applications, and future directions.
zh_title: 现代医学中的人工智能：技术、应用与未来方向综述
summary: 综述检索 PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science（2016–2024），区分回顾性算法表现与前瞻性临床有效性，涵盖影像、药物发现与多组学等。
key_points: 仅纳入同行评审研究与临床试验
DL、NLP、基础模型在回顾性队列中准确率高
AI 加速药物发现并支持多组学整合
reason: 泛泛综述，受综述上限约束，增量有限
abstract: [Personalized medicine] We evaluated the transformative impact of AI modalities on clinical practice, distinguishing between retrospective algorithmic performance and prospective clinical effectiveness. Comprehensive searches were executed [databases searched: January 2016 to October 2024] across PubMed/Medline, Scopus, and Web of Science, identifying peer-reviewed original research and clinical trials. Non-peer-reviewed materials and commercial web sources were strictly excluded. AI technologies-particularly deep learning (DL), natural language processing (NLP), and foundation models-demonstrate high diagnostic accuracy in retrospective cohorts across radiology, dermatology, and pathology. In precision therapeutics, AI accelerates drug discovery and facilitates multi-omics integration for individualized treatment planning. Furthermore, autonomous AI systems have proven cost-effective in nationwide diabetic retinopathy screening programs. However, significant gaps remain between in-silico success and real-world clinical utility. Primary barriers include the lack of prospective randomized trials, pervasive risks of algorithmic bias threatening health equity, the "black box" nature of deep neural networks, and stringent interoperability challenges. AI serves as a potent computational catalyst for advancing personalized medicine. To transition from retrospective experimental success to standard-of-care clinical integration, future research endeavors must prioritize Explainable AI (XAI), federated learning frameworks for privacy preservation, and rigorous prospective clinical validation under standardized regulatory oversight.
zh_abstract: [个体化医学] 我们评估了人工智能（AI）各类模式对临床实践的变革性影响，并区分了回顾性算法性能与前瞻性临床有效性。我们在 PubMed/Medline、Scopus 和 Web of Science 中进行了全面检索［检索时间范围：2016年1月至2024年10月］，纳入经同行评审的原创研究和临床试验；未经同行评审的资料和商业网络来源被严格排除。AI 技术——尤其是深度学习（DL）、自然语言处理（NLP）和基础模型（foundation models）——在放射学、皮肤病学和病理学的回顾性队列中显示出较高的诊断准确性。在精准治疗方面，AI 可加速药物研发，并促进多组学整合以制定个体化治疗方案。此外，自主式 AI 系统已在全国性糖尿病视网膜病变筛查项目中被证明具有成本效益。然而，计算机模拟（in-silico）层面的成功与真实世界临床实用性之间仍存在显著差距。主要障碍包括：缺乏前瞻性随机试验、普遍存在的算法偏倚风险威胁健康公平、深度神经网络的“黑箱”特性，以及严格的互操作性挑战。AI 是推动个体化医学发展的有力计算催化剂。要从回顾性实验成功过渡到标准诊疗中的临床整合，未来研究必须优先发展可解释 AI（XAI）、用于隐私保护的联邦学习框架，并在标准化监管下开展严格的前瞻性临床验证。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Acute Coronary Syndromes: From Early Diagnosis to Culprit Lesion Characterization, Coronary Physiology, and Risk Stratification.
zh_title: 急性冠脉综合征中的人工智能：从早期诊断到风险分层
summary: 综述AI在ACS全流程的应用，包括AI心电图检测OMI、结合肌钙蛋白的早期排除、冠脉影像斑块量化及风险预测。
key_points: AI心电图可提高OMI检出
模型结合临床数据与高敏肌钙蛋白
AI辅助OCT/IVUS判读与斑块量化
reason: 叙述性综述，上限6，内容泛泛属增量档
abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Artificial intelligence (AI) is being investigated across the acute coronary syndrome (ACS) care pathway, including early diagnosis, coronary lesion characterization, procedural guidance, and risk prediction. This comprehensive review examines the current evidence across the entire ACS trajectory, with particular emphasis on clinically actionable and interventional applications. AI-enabled electrocardiography (ECG) may improve detection of myocardial infarction, including occlusion myocardial infarction (OMI) that does not meet conventional STEMI criteria. Models combining clinical data and high-sensitivity troponin may improve early rule-out and rule-in. In coronary imaging, AI can quantify plaque characteristics and assist with the interpretation of OCT and IVUS, while image-derived physiology may help assess non-culprit lesions. However, better diagnostic accuracy does not necessarily translate into better revascularization decisions. AI-based models can also estimate post-ACS ischemic, bleeding, and mortality risk, although evidence that their use improves treatment or outcomes remains limited. The next priority is prospective evaluation of whether these tools improve decisions, workflow, and patient outcomes across diverse clinical settings.
zh_abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] 人工智能（AI）正被广泛研究应用于急性冠脉综合征（ACS）诊疗全流程，包括早期诊断、冠状动脉病变特征分析、操作指导和风险预测。本综述全面审视了贯穿ACS整个病程的现有证据，并特别强调具有临床可操作性及介入相关的应用。基于AI的心电图（ECG）可能改善心肌梗死的检出，包括不符合传统STEMI标准的闭塞性心肌梗死（OMI）。结合临床数据与高敏肌钙蛋白的模型可能改善早期排除和确诊。在冠状动脉影像方面，AI可以量化斑块特征并辅助解读OCT和IVUS，而基于影像的生理学评估可能有助于评估非罪犯病变。然而，更高的诊断准确性并不一定转化为更好的血运重建决策。基于AI的模型还可以估计ACS后的缺血、出血和死亡风险，但关于其应用能否改善治疗或结局的证据仍然有限。下一步的重点是开展前瞻性评估，检验这些工具能否在多样化的临床环境中改善决策、工作流程和患者结局。

title: Artificial intelligence and machine learning for magnetic nanoparticles and nanocarriers in cancer imaging, drug delivery, and magnetic control: a systematic review.
zh_title: 磁性纳米颗粒癌症成像与递送中的AI/机器学习：系统综述
summary: PRISMA系统综述纳入65项研究，梳理AI/ML在MRI可见磁性纳米颗粒的成像、药物递送、热疗和磁控中的应用，证据集中于边界明确的任务。
key_points: 7个数据库2,283条记录筛选出65项研究
预测稳定性、毒性、弛豫率、SAR、药物释放等
磁性与弛豫率预测、SPION成像等任务证据最强
reason: 系统综述但纳入研究多为孤立终点，领域偏窄，属增量档
abstract: [Beilstein journal of nanotechnology] We reviewed artificial intelligence and machine learning in magnetic resonance imaging-visible magnetic nanoparticles, nanocarriers, and systems for imaging, drug delivery, hyperthermia, targeting, transport, and control. Using "preferred reporting items for systematic reviews and meta-analyses (PRISMA) 2020" methods, 2,283 records from seven databases yielded 65 studies. Predicted outcomes were colloidal stability, toxicity, uptake, magnetic descriptors, specific absorption rate, relaxivity, MRI signal, superparamagnetic iron oxide nanoparticle (SPION) quantification, drug release, biodistribution, and magnetic navigation. Evidence was strongest in bounded tasks: magnetic-property and relaxivity prediction, image-derived SPION mapping, hyperthermia modelling, and controlled magnetic transport. Most studies optimised isolated endpoints rather than integrating stability, MRI visibility, drug loading, release, tumour delivery, safety, and therapeutic response. External validation across datasets, laboratories, particle batches, biological models, scanners, and patient cohorts remains limited.

title: Fusion of Deep Learning Radiomics and Clinical Features for Individualized Prediction of Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy Response in Osteosarcoma.

summary: 回顾性纳入198例骨肉瘤患者，用治疗前T2加权MRI与临床数据，比较12种CNN，DenseNet121交叉验证AUC最高（0.775），并与临床变量融合建模。

DenseNet121平均交叉验证AUC 0.775

abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Background: Stage IIB conventional osteosarcoma exhibits highly heterogeneous responses to neoadjuvant chemotherapy, necessitating reliable, noninvasive pre-treatment evaluation systems. Methods: This retrospective study of 198 patients utilized pre-treatment T2-weighted magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and baseline clinical data. Twelve classical convolutional neural network architectures were benchmarked to identify the optimal imaging backbone. This selected radiomics score was then integrated with core clinical variables using logistic regression to construct a multimodal model. Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping++ (Grad-CAM++) and SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) algorithms provided image- and feature-level interpretability. Results: DenseNet121 achieved the highest mean cross-validated area under the curve (AUC; 0.775) and was selected, with AUCs of 0.797 (95% CI: 0.716-0.877) and 0.701 (95% CI: 0.513-0.877) in the training and test cohorts. Adding the clinical variables improved discrimination, yielding a test-cohort AUC of 0.827 (95% CI: 0.661-0.992) with significant reclassification gain over the radiomics-only model (NRI = 1.28, IDI = 0.177; DeLong p = 0.011). Grad-CAM++ activation concentrated on the solid medullary and extraosseous soft-tissue components, and SHAP ranked the radiomics score as the strongest contributor. Conclusions: Integrating deep learning radiomics with key clinical features provides a noninvasive tool for the individualized prediction of neoadjuvant chemosensitivity in osteosarcoma.
zh_abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)]【背景】IIB期经典型骨肉瘤对新辅助化疗的反应高度异质，因此需要可靠的无创治疗前评估系统。【方法】这项回顾性研究纳入198例患者，利用治疗前T2加权磁共振成像（MRI）和基线临床数据。对12种经典卷积神经网络架构进行基准测试，以确定最优的影像主干网络。随后将所选的影像组学评分与核心临床变量通过逻辑回归整合，构建多模态模型。梯度加权类激活映射++（Grad-CAM++）和SHapley加性解释（SHAP）算法提供了图像层面和特征层面的可解释性。【结果】DenseNet121取得了最高的平均交叉验证曲线下面积（AUC；0.775）并被选用，其在训练集和测试集中的AUC分别为0.797（95% CI：0.716-0.877）和0.701（95% CI：0.513-0.877）。加入临床变量后区分能力提高，测试集AUC为0.827（95% CI：0.661-0.992），相较仅用影像组学的模型具有显著的重分类增益（NRI = 1.28，IDI = 0.177；DeLong p = 0.011）。Grad-CAM++激活集中于实性髓内成分和骨外软组织成分，SHAP将影像组学评分列为贡献最大的因素。【结论】将深度学习影像组学与关键临床特征相结合，可为骨肉瘤新辅助化疗敏感性的个体化预测提供一种无创工具。

title: Evaluation of Large Language Model Concordance With AAOS Clinical Practice Guidelines for Carpal Tunnel Syndrome.
zh_title: 大语言模型与AAOS腕管综合征指南的一致性评估
summary: 四种LLM对252条腕管综合征推荐的回答由两名盲评者分级，72.6%与AAOS指南一致。

共252条推荐，72.6%一致

abstract: [Hand (New York, N.Y.)] Large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Mistral are increasingly used to obtain medical information, but their accuracy in carpal tunnel syndrome (CTS) management is uncertain. This study evaluated whether LLM-generated recommendations align with American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons (AAOS) clinical practice guidelines (CPGs). Four LLMs (ChatGPT-4, Gemini, Claude-3, Mistral-7B) were queried with standardized prompts derived from AAOS CTS CPGs. Each prompt was asked 3 times per model, and responses were synthesized. Two blinded reviewers graded outputs as concordant, discordant, or indeterminate, with disagreements resolved by consensus. Concordance distributions were compared using χ2 testing with Bonferroni correction. Inter-rater reliability was measured with Cohen's κ. Across 252 recommendations, 72.6% were concordant, 11.5% discordant, and 15.9% indeterminate. ChatGPT achieved the highest concordance (92.1%) and lowest discordance (1.6%), while Mistral performed poorest (52.4% concordance, 17.5% discordance). Reviewer agreement was excellent (κ = 0.91). Over 1 in 4 LLM-generated CTS recommendations were not concordant with AAOS CPGs. ChatGPT outperformed other models, though variable performance underscores the need for clinician oversight and careful validation before clinical use.
zh_abstract: [Hand (New York, N.Y.)] 大型语言模型（LLM），如ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude和Mistral，越来越多地被用于获取医学信息，但其在腕管综合征（CTS）管理方面的准确性尚不确定。本研究评估了LLM生成的建议是否与美国矫形外科医师学会（AAOS）临床实践指南（CPG）一致。使用源自AAOS CTS CPG的标准化提示词向四种LLM（ChatGPT-4、Gemini、Claude-3、Mistral-7B）提问。每个提示词对每个模型询问3次，并对回答进行综合。两名盲法评审者将输出分级为一致、不一致或不确定，分歧通过协商解决。采用χ2检验并进行Bonferroni校正比较一致性分布。以Cohen's κ衡量评审者间信度。在252条建议中，72.6%一致，11.5%不一致，15.9%不确定。ChatGPT的一致性最高（92.1%）、不一致率最低（1.6%），而Mistral表现最差（一致性52.4%，不一致率17.5%）。评审者间一致性极佳（κ = 0.91）。超过四分之一的LLM生成的CTS建议与AAOS CPG不一致。ChatGPT优于其他模型，但表现的差异凸显了在临床使用前需要临床医生监督和审慎验证。

abstract: [Professional case management] The literature review is saturated with positive tones about the use of AI not only in health care but also in all aspects of our daily lives as well. The positivity range is extensive, ranging from increased accuracy, efficiency, productivity, profitability to creativity, equity, and advancement. Yet, the public is circumspect with continual exposure to news about cybersecurity threats or attacks, identity theft, violations of privacy, and challenges of establishing trust in their daily encounters with technology amidst prevalence of deep fakes, voice cloning, and AI-generated images or videos of people. A meta-synthesis of AI-related literature inclusive of expert panels is examined as an exploratory search for AI applicability and use in the health care landscape. The purpose of this article is to demystify AI highlighting areas of its use in health care, ways for clinicians specifically, care managers to bridge that divide and ascertain key practice standards with emphasis on its ethical use in health care. The settings using AI that were considered in this article include Health plans, Hospitals, medical practices or clinics, and Hospitals' Revenue Cycle Management (RCM). Implications and recommendations for case management engagement in AI are addressed relative to the standards of practice (SOPs).
zh_abstract: 【专业病例管理】文献综述中充斥着对人工智能（AI）应用的积极论调，这不仅限于医疗保健领域，也涉及我们日常生活的各个方面。这种积极性涵盖范围广泛，从准确性、效率、生产力、盈利能力的提升，到创造力、公平性和进步。然而，公众仍持审慎态度，因为他们不断接触到有关网络安全威胁或攻击、身份盗窃、隐私侵犯的新闻，并且在深度伪造、语音克隆以及AI生成的人物图像或视频盛行的情况下，在日常接触技术时面临建立信任的挑战。本文对包括专家小组在内的AI相关文献进行了元综合分析，作为对AI在医疗保健领域适用性和使用情况的探索性检索。本文旨在揭开AI的神秘面纱，重点介绍其在医疗保健中的应用领域，探讨临床医生（特别是照护管理者）如何弥合这一鸿沟，并确定关键的实践标准，重点关注其在医疗保健中的伦理使用。本文所考虑的使用AI的场景包括健康计划、医院、医疗机构或诊所，以及医院的收入周期管理（RCM）。本文结合实践标准（SOPs）阐述了病例管理参与AI的意义和建议。

title: Explainable Multimodal AI Approach to Reduce Unnecessary Breast Biopsies
zh_title: 可解释多模态AI减少不必要的乳腺活检
summary: 提出结合ViT影像与DeBERTa报告文本的多模态模型，用Grad-CAM解释，预测BI-RADS 4/5患者活检是否为良性。
key_points: ViT提取乳腺X线特征，DeBERTa-V3-Large提取报告文本

abstract: Recently, there has been rise in multimodal vision-language models for computer-aided diagnosis (CAD), yet their application in breast diagnosis, particularly for predicting biopsy outcomes remains limited. This study presents a multimodal vision-language approach, incorporating Grad-CAM as an Explainable AI (XAI) technique, to predict benign tumors in patients recommended for biopsy, especially those classified as BI-RADS 4 and 5. A novel multimodal framework was devel- oped using Vision Transformer (ViT) for imaging feature extraction and DeBERTa-V3-Large for textual embeddings. The model was trained and evaluated on a comprehensive in-house dataset comprising 1,632 patients, each with four mammography views and a corresponding radiology report. The features of both modalities were extracted independently and fused by late fusion before classification. Grad-CAM was used to generate visual explanations highlighting key regions influencing model predictions. The proposed model demonstrated high sensitivity 90%, 95%, 99%, and 100% with corresponding specificities of 40%, 36%, 18%, and 11%, respectively. The best AUC achieved was 0.72 by multimodal approach on the test set, outperforming the image only (0.66) and text-only (0.68) baselines. The proposed multimodal architecture, enhanced with Grad-CAM, demonstrates a strong potential to identify benign tumors among high-risk patients, offering interpretable insights and thereby helping reduce unnecessary biopsies, patient anxiety, and healthcare costs.
zh_abstract: 近来，用于计算机辅助诊断（CAD）的多模态视觉-语言模型日益增多，但其在乳腺诊断中的应用，尤其是预测活检结果方面仍然有限。本研究提出一种多模态视觉-语言方法，并结合 Grad-CAM 作为可解释 AI（XAI）技术，用于预测被建议活检的患者（尤其是 BI-RADS 4 类和 5 类患者）中的良性肿瘤。我们开发了一种新型多模态框架，采用视觉 Transformer（ViT）提取影像特征，采用 DeBERTa-V3-Large 生成文本嵌入。模型在一个包含 1,632 例患者的综合性内部数据集上进行训练和评估，每例患者均有四个乳腺X线摄影体位及相应的放射学报告。两种模态的特征分别独立提取，并在分类前通过后期融合（late fusion）进行整合。Grad-CAM 用于生成视觉解释，突出显示影响模型预测的关键区域。所提出的模型表现出 90%、95%、99% 和 100% 的高敏感度，对应的特异度分别为 40%、36%、18% 和 11%。在测试集上，多模态方法取得的最佳 AUC 为 0.72，优于仅用图像（0.66）和仅用文本（0.68）的基线。结合 Grad-CAM 的所提多模态架构在识别高风险患者中的良性肿瘤方面显示出较强潜力，可提供可解释的见解，从而有助于减少不必要的活检、患者焦虑和医疗费用。

title: DocTalk: Enhancing Medical Knowledge Retrieval via Fine-tuned Large Language Models with Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Robust Clinical Decision Support

构建500对问答，含专家审核与思维链提问

abstract: Objective: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) in healthcare has opened new possibilities for AI-assisted clinical decision-making; however, safe and effective deployment remains challenging because of hallucination and domain misalignment. This study introduces DocTalk, a doctor-assistive question-answering (QA) system designed to generate concise, chart-grounded responses from de-identified discharge summaries. Methods: We developed a high-fidelity data generation pipeline that produces 500 clinically relevant QA pairs through sentence-level decomposition, chain-of-thought-guided question formulation, and expert review. Six open-source LLMs, including three general-purpose and three biomedical models, were evaluated before and after parameter-efficient instruction tuning using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). The framework integrates prompt engineering, in-context learning, and medically aligned evaluation to support factual and interpretable responses. Results: On DocTalk-QA, instruction tuning produced consistent improvements across lexical, semantic, and clinical fidelity metrics. The best-performing tuned model, Llama-3-Med42-8B, achieved ROUGE-L = 0.40, BERTScore-F1 = 0.76, and UMLS-F1 = 0.49. To examine external generalization beyond the DocTalk-QA dataset, the two best-performing models, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Llama-3-Med42-8B, were evaluated on PubMedQA before and after instruction tuning. Accuracy improved from 0.931 to 0.977 for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and from 0.935 to 0.943 for Llama-3-Med42-8B. Conclusion: DocTalk was deployed as a secure web-based platform for interactive EHR querying. These findings suggest that clinically grounded instruction tuning can improve medical QA performance and support practical clinical decision support.
zh_abstract: 【目的】大语言模型（LLM）在医疗领域的快速发展为人工智能辅助临床决策开辟了新的可能；然而，由于幻觉和领域不匹配问题，其安全有效的部署仍具挑战。本研究介绍了 DocTalk，这是一种面向医生的辅助问答（QA）系统，旨在基于去标识化的出院小结生成简洁、以病历为依据的回答。【方法】我们开发了一条高保真数据生成流程，通过句子级分解、思维链引导的问题构建和专家审核，生成了500个具有临床相关性的问答对。我们评估了六个开源 LLM（包括三个通用模型和三个生物医学模型）在使用低秩适应（LoRA）进行参数高效指令微调前后的表现。该框架整合了提示工程、上下文学习以及与医学对齐的评估，以支持生成符合事实且可解释的回答。【结果】在 DocTalk-QA 上，指令微调在词汇、语义和临床保真度指标上均带来一致的提升。表现最佳的微调模型 Llama-3-Med42-8B 取得了 ROUGE-L = 0.40、BERTScore-F1 = 0.76 和 UMLS-F1 = 0.49。为检验 DocTalk-QA 数据集之外的外部泛化能力，对表现最佳的两个模型 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 和 Llama-3-Med42-8B 在指令微调前后于 PubMedQA 上进行了评估。Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 的准确率从 0.931 提高到 0.977，Llama-3-Med42-8B 的准确率从 0.935 提高到 0.943。【结论】DocTalk 已作为安全的网页平台部署，用于交互式电子病历查询。这些发现提示，以临床为基础的指令微调可以提升医学问答性能，并支持实际的临床决策支持。

title: Beyond Federated Learning: Decentralized Agentic Systems for Self-Evolving Clinical Intelligence
zh_title: 超越联邦学习：面向自进化临床智能的去中心化智能体系统
summary: 预印本观点文章提出去中心化智能体系统（DAS），主张跨机构共享抽象推理轨迹而非原始数据或模型参数。

各机构智能体共享抽象推理轨迹
对比联邦学习的梯度平均范式

abstract: Clinical expertise is inherently distributed: it resides not in any single dataset or institution but in the accumulated reasoning experiences of thousands of clinicians navigating diverse patient populations, resource constraints, and evolving treatment protocols. Yet current approaches to scaling medical AI, from centralized large language models to federated learning, remain anchored to a data-centric paradigm that treats knowledge as static parameters to be aggregated. In this Perspective, we argue for a fundamental shift from data aggregation to experience aggregation. We propose Decentralized Agentic Systems (DAS), a framework in which distributed AI agents operating across healthcare institutions synthesize collective clinical intelligence by sharing abstracted reasoning trajectories rather than raw data or model parameters. Unlike federated learning, which averages numerical gradients across homogeneous model architectures, DAS exchanges structured records of clinical reasoning, specifically the sequence of observations, hypotheses, tool invocations, and outcome feedback that constitute diagnostic experience. We examine the architectural principles, deployment considerations, governance requirements, and critical open challenges of this framework, laying the groundwork for a collaborative medical AI ecosystem where distributed expertise autonomously adapts to the complexities of longitudinal patient care.
zh_abstract: 临床专业知识本质上是分布式的：它并不存在于任何单一数据集或机构中，而是存在于成千上万名临床医生在应对不同患者群体、资源限制和不断演变的治疗方案过程中积累的推理经验之中。然而，目前扩展医疗 AI 的方法，从集中式大语言模型到联邦学习，仍然固守以数据为中心的范式，将知识视为需要聚合的静态参数。在本观点文章中，我们主张从数据聚合转向经验聚合。我们提出去中心化智能体系统（Decentralized Agentic Systems，DAS）这一框架，其中跨医疗机构运行的分布式 AI 智能体通过共享抽象化的推理轨迹（而非原始数据或模型参数）来综合集体临床智能。联邦学习是在同质模型架构之间对数值梯度取平均，与之不同，DAS 交换的是结构化的临床推理记录，具体而言是构成诊断经验的观察、假设、工具调用和结果反馈序列。我们考察了该框架的架构原则、部署考量、治理要求和关键的未决挑战，为构建协作式医疗 AI 生态系统奠定基础，使分布式专业知识能够自主适应纵向患者照护的复杂性。

title: Low-rank MERA Decomposition of 3D OCT Image Volume for Compression, Denoising, Feature Extraction and Diagnosis of Retinal Diseases

abstract: Optical coherence tomography (OCT) is a non-invasive imaging modality used for visualization of retinal tissue. However, OCT volumes are affected by speckle noise, which degrades image contrast and obscures fine structural details. Furthermore, modern clinical practice requires large field-of-view, high-resolution OCT volumes, whose storage and transmission are demanding for archiving and teleophthalmology applications. To address aforementioned challenges, we propose a low-rank multi-scale entanglement renormalization ansatz (MERA) tensor network approximation of 3D OCT image volume, where the image volume is represented as contractions of a top core factor encoding global features and multiple interacting low-rank orthogonal or semi-orthogonal factors modeling inter- and intra-B scan correlations. This representation jointly enables compression, denoising, and feature extraction. Unlike deep learning approaches, the proposed approach is training-free and processes each OCT volume independently. We evaluate the proposed framework on OCT image volumes acquired by two different scanners and demonstrate improved visual quality and reduced retinal layer segmentation errors in comparison with several competing methods. We also extract MERA features from two clinical OCT volume datasets. They are subsequently classified using a Grassmann-manifold nearest-subspace classifier. With the subspace dimension as its only hyperparameter, the classifier is theoretically shown to be robust in small-sample clinical scenario. We demonstrate competitive accuracy of classification of retinal diseases in these small-sample settings, where deep learning methods are often limited by the scarcity of labeled data. The proposed structure-aware model-driven representation learning for high-dimensional data under limited supervision provides good generalization performance while maintaining high interpretability.
zh_abstract: 光学相干断层扫描（OCT）是一种用于视网膜组织可视化的无创成像方式。然而，OCT 体数据受散斑噪声影响，会降低图像对比度并掩盖精细的结构细节。此外，现代临床实践需要大视野、高分辨率的 OCT 体数据，其存储和传输对于归档和远程眼科应用而言要求很高。为应对上述挑战，我们提出一种对三维 OCT 图像体数据的低秩多尺度纠缠重整化拟设（MERA）张量网络近似：图像体数据被表示为一个编码全局特征的顶层核心因子，与多个相互作用、用于建模 B 扫描间及 B 扫描内相关性的低秩正交或半正交因子的收缩。该表示可同时实现压缩、去噪和特征提取。与深度学习方法不同，所提方法无需训练，并且独立处理每个 OCT 体数据。我们在两种不同扫描仪采集的 OCT 图像体数据上评估了所提框架，结果显示，与若干对比方法相比，其视觉质量有所改善，视网膜层分割误差有所降低。我们还从两个临床 OCT 体数据集中提取了 MERA 特征，随后使用 Grassmann 流形最近子空间分类器对其进行分类。该分类器以子空间维度作为唯一超参数，理论上已证明其在小样本临床场景中具有鲁棒性。在深度学习方法常因标注数据稀缺而受限的这些小样本设置下，我们展示了其在视网膜疾病分类方面具有竞争力的准确性。所提出的这种在有限监督下针对高维数据的结构感知、模型驱动的表示学习方法，在保持高可解释性的同时具有良好的泛化性能。

title: O2D-MedNet: An Optimization-Aware Dual-Domain Framework for Robust Medical Image Segmentation

summary: 提出融合傅里叶与小波域特征的双域分割框架，包含退化感知交互模块和跨骨干轮廓引导融合模块。
key_points: 傅里叶与小波域特征交互以抑制退化
跨骨干轮廓引导融合模块

reason: 预印本分割方法改进，摘要未见外部验证
abstract: Medical image segmentation (MIS) remains challenging due to composite degradations and multi-scale geometric variations, which jointly impair lesion-background separability, structural consistency, and optimization stability. Existing single-stream frameworks entangle heterogeneous cues within a single representation pathway, while hybrid-stream approaches often rely on generic or static fusion, limiting effective coordination across domains and failing to explicitly address optimization instability. To overcome these limitations, we propose a new optimization-aware dual-domain framework for MIS (O2D-MedNet). First, a degradation-aware dualdomain interaction (DDI) module integrates Fourier - and Wavelet-domain features to suppress degradation-sensitive responses while preserving structural and fine-detail information. Second, a cross-backbone contour-guided fusion (CGF) module enables selective interaction between CNN-based local detail modeling and visual state-space-based global structure modeling, improving boundary accuracy and representation consistency. Third, a gradient-context optimization (GCO) strategy stabilizes training by adaptively adjusting learning dynamics based on loss trends and gradient statistics, mitigating instability caused by class imbalance and heterogeneous sample difficulty. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art MIS methods across multiple imaging modalities. Further analyses confirm enhanced sensitivity, structural consistency, and optimization stability, validating the effectiveness of the proposed O2D-MedNet for robust MIS under heterogeneous conditions.
zh_abstract: 医学图像分割（MIS）仍具挑战性，原因在于复合退化和多尺度几何变化，它们共同损害病灶与背景的可分性、结构一致性和优化稳定性。现有的单流框架将异质线索纠缠在单一表示路径中，而混合流方法常依赖通用或静态融合，限制了跨域的有效协同，也未能明确解决优化不稳定问题。为克服这些局限，我们提出了一种新的面向优化的双域MIS框架（O2D-MedNet）。首先，退化感知双域交互（DDI）模块整合傅里叶域和小波域特征，以抑制对退化敏感的响应，同时保留结构和精细细节信息。其次，跨骨干轮廓引导融合（CGF）模块实现基于CNN的局部细节建模与基于视觉状态空间的全局结构建模之间的选择性交互，从而提高边界精度和表示一致性。第三，梯度-上下文优化（GCO）策略根据损失趋势和梯度统计自适应调整学习动态，从而稳定训练，缓解由类别不平衡和样本难度异质性引起的不稳定。在六个基准上的大量实验表明，该方法在多种成像模态上均持续优于最先进的MIS方法。进一步分析证实了其灵敏度、结构一致性和优化稳定性的提升，验证了所提出的O2D-MedNet在异质条件下实现稳健MIS的有效性。

title: Mimic: A Unified Neural Network Architecture for Modelling Genomic Sequences and Module-level Comparison
zh_title: Mimic：用于基因组序列建模与模块级比较的统一神经网络架构
summary: 分析既有基因组序列神经网络，提出统一架构Mimic，便于对k-mer嵌入、序列嵌入等组件做有原则的比较，并处理不同序列长度。
key_points: 已有网络多按序列嵌入组件区分
统一架构可支持可变序列长度
用于蛋白-DNA相互作用等基因组数据集

abstract: There exist a wide range of Neural Networks (NNs) that have modelled genomic sequences well. The architectures of these NNs consist of three steps: k-mer embedding, sequence embedding, and output mapping. The NNs are primarily differentiated from one another by their sequence embedding components. Although different NNs have been compared before, these comparisons are often either limited or involve drastically different NNs. Another issue is that some NNs are configured for a specific sequence length, and different length sequences require manual modification of the architectures. This study examines the architectures of established NNs for genomics sequences. Based on these architectures, a novel NN called Mimic is developed that provides a unified architecture for the principled comparison of NN components. Mimic was used to model two different types of genomic datasets: protein-DNA interactions and enhancer activity. Along with other architecture components, different sequence embedding strategies were tried such as recurrent layers and convolutional layers. It was found that there exist specific NN components that yield significantly better performing models. Furthermore, Mimic significantly outperformed prevailing standard NNs, Bichrom and DeepSTARR, in modelling protein-DNA interactions and enhancer activity, respectively. This study provides a framework for more extensive studies toward a general prescription of NN architecture for modelling genomics data.
zh_abstract: 目前已有多种能够很好地对基因组序列建模的神经网络（NN）。这些神经网络的架构包含三个步骤：k-mer 嵌入、序列嵌入和输出映射。各神经网络之间的区别主要在于其序列嵌入部分。尽管此前已有对不同神经网络的比较，但这些比较往往要么范围有限，要么涉及差异极大的神经网络。另一个问题是，一些神经网络是针对特定序列长度配置的，不同长度的序列需要手动修改其架构。本研究考察了已有的基因组序列神经网络的架构。基于这些架构，开发了一种名为 Mimic 的新型神经网络，它为神经网络各组件的原则性比较提供了统一的架构。Mimic 被用于对两类不同的基因组数据集建模：蛋白质-DNA 相互作用和增强子活性。除其他架构组件外，还尝试了不同的序列嵌入策略，如循环层和卷积层。研究发现，存在某些特定的神经网络组件可显著提升模型性能。此外，在蛋白质-DNA 相互作用和增强子活性的建模中，Mimic 分别显著优于当前主流的标准神经网络 Bichrom 和 DeepSTARR。本研究为开展更广泛的研究、进而形成基因组数据建模所用神经网络架构的通用规范提供了框架。

title: Identification of gene kinetics patterns improves RNA velocity and cell fate prediction using JuloVelo
zh_title: JuloVelo：基因动力学模式识别改进RNA速度与细胞命运预测
summary: 深度学习框架先识别基因动力学模式再初始化网络，用于改进单细胞RNA速度和细胞命运预测。

abstract: Single-cell RNA velocity has transformed our capacity to predict future cell states from sequencing snapshots, but existing methods rely on constant or binary kinetic assumptions that fail to capture the heterogeneous splicing dynamics of cellular differentiation. Here we present JuloVelo, a deep learning framework that demonstrates that identifying gene kinetics patterns to initialize neural network training dramatically improves RNA velocity model performance. By pre-determining whether each gene follows a Circle, Complete induction, or Complete repression pattern across cellular differentiation, JuloVelo initializes training with pattern-matched, pre-trained network weights, effectively guiding the cell-specific kinetics optimization away from biologically implausible parameter regimes. Additionally, JuloVelo demonstrates that multiome datasets can also be processed and modeled by utilizing promoter chromatin accessibility to guide kinetics pre-determination, and integrates an in silico perturbation framework to simulate transcription factor modulation on cell fate. Validated across eight datasets spanning erythrogenesis, neurogenesis, and endocrinogenesis, JuloVelo consistently outperformed constant-rate and cell-specific models, resolving the entire five-lineage differentiation program in hippocampal neurogenesis. Multiome processing improved both intrinsic and extrinsic velocity stability, and JuloVelo reduced computational execution time by approximately 70% compared to cellDancer. JuloVelo is available as an open-source package at https://github.com/jhlabtw/JuloVelo.jl.
zh_abstract: 单细胞RNA速率（RNA velocity）极大提升了我们从测序快照预测细胞未来状态的能力，但现有方法依赖恒定或二元的动力学假设，无法刻画细胞分化过程中异质性的剪接动力学。在此，我们提出JuloVelo，一个深度学习框架，证明通过识别基因动力学模式来初始化神经网络训练，可显著提升RNA速率模型的性能。JuloVelo预先确定每个基因在细胞分化过程中遵循环状（Circle）、完全诱导（Complete induction）还是完全抑制（Complete repression）模式，并使用与模式匹配的预训练网络权重来初始化训练，从而有效引导细胞特异性动力学优化避开生物学上不合理的参数区间。此外，JuloVelo证明多组学（multiome）数据集同样可以通过利用启动子染色质可及性来指导动力学预判定而得到处理和建模，并整合了in silico扰动框架，用于模拟转录因子调控对细胞命运的影响。在涵盖红细胞生成、神经发生和内分泌发生的八个数据集上验证显示，JuloVelo始终优于恒定速率模型和细胞特异性模型，并解析了海马神经发生中完整的五谱系分化程序。多组学处理提高了内在和外在速率稳定性，且与cellDancer相比，JuloVelo将计算执行时间缩短约70%。JuloVelo以开源软件包形式提供，网址为 https://github.com/jhlabtw/JuloVelo.jl。

title: Machine Learning in Amyloidogenic Polypeptide Research: From Sequence Prediction to Drug Discovery.
zh_title: 淀粉样多肽研究中的机器学习：从序列预测到药物发现
summary: 综述系统评述机器学习在淀粉样多肽研究中的应用，涵盖序列预测、结构生物学、抑制剂设计及临床目标，并梳理从经典算法到Transformer、蛋白语言模型的架构。
key_points: 覆盖序列致淀粉样性预测与结构生物学
涉及抑制剂设计与临床相关目标
梳理经典算法至深度学习及蛋白语言模型
reason: 综述类，上限6；与神经退行性疾病和药物发现相关，但属泛泛综述
abstract: [ACS omega] Over the past decade, machine learning (ML) has established a transformative paradigm for investigating amyloidogenic polypeptides. Characterized by their propensity to form ordered, β-sheet-rich fibrillar aggregates, these polypeptides are centrally implicated in the pathogenesis of numerous neurodegenerative diseases, including Alzheimer's disease (AD) and Parkinson's disease (PD). This review systematically evaluates the application of ML across critical domains of amyloid investigation: sequence-based amyloidogenicity prediction, structural biology, inhibitor design, and amyloid-related clinical objectives. We further summarize the diverse array of ML architectures currently employed in amyloid research, spanning classical algorithms (e.g., support vector machines and random forests) to advanced deep learning frameworks, such as the transformer framework, protein language models (PLMs), etc. Additionally, we spotlight emerging frontiers, namely, the integration of ML with molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, the use of generative AI for de novo inhibitor design, etc., while addressing persistent bottlenecks in the field, including data standardization, model interpretability, and rigorous experimental validation for in silico predictions. Ultimately, this review serves as a foundational roadmap for emerging researchers and a definitive reference for established investigators operating at the intersection of artificial intelligence and amyloid biology.
zh_abstract: [ACS omega] 在过去十年中，机器学习（ML）为淀粉样多肽的研究确立了一种变革性范式。这些多肽的特点是倾向于形成有序的、富含β-折叠的纤维状聚集体，与包括阿尔茨海默病（AD）和帕金森病（PD）在内的多种神经退行性疾病的发病机制密切相关。本综述系统评估了ML在淀粉样蛋白研究若干关键领域中的应用：基于序列的淀粉样生成倾向预测、结构生物学、抑制剂设计以及与淀粉样蛋白相关的临床目标。我们进一步总结了目前淀粉样蛋白研究中所采用的多种ML架构，涵盖从经典算法（如支持向量机和随机森林）到先进的深度学习框架（如Transformer框架、蛋白质语言模型（PLM）等）。此外，我们重点介绍了新兴前沿方向，即ML与分子动力学（MD）模拟的结合、利用生成式人工智能从头设计抑制剂等，同时探讨了该领域长期存在的瓶颈，包括数据标准化、模型可解释性，以及对计算机预测结果进行严格实验验证。总之，本综述为新入行的研究人员提供了基础性路线图，也为处于人工智能与淀粉样蛋白生物学交叉领域的资深研究者提供了权威参考。

title: Evaluating a Large Language Model for Emergency Triage Using Synthetic Clinical Dialogues: Toward a Multimodal Clinical Safety Framework.
zh_title: 用合成临床对话评估大模型的急诊分诊能力
summary: 研究以合成临床对话评估GPT-5.2在朝觐场景下的急诊分诊（ESI），并探索结合结构化电子病历与对话的多模态安全框架。
key_points: 场景为朝觐等大规模聚集活动的急诊分诊
使用合成对话结合结构化生理指标
面向概念性临床决策支持框架

abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Background/Objectives: Prioritizing patient safety through accurate emergency triage is critical during mass-gathering events such as Hajj and Umrah, where high patient volumes can significantly increase the risk of clinical errors. Although the Emergency Severity Index (ESI) provides a standardized triage protocol, it remains dependent on human judgment, while traditional artificial intelligence (AI) models often struggle to capture the nuanced clinical context embedded in patient narratives. To address this gap, this study evaluates GPT-5.2 using synthetically generated dialogues as a step toward a conceptual clinical decision-support framework that bridges structured electronic health records (EHRs) with triage interactions through clinical dialogues. By combining narrative inputs with structured physiological indicators, it explores the potential to support more informed clinical decision-making under controlled simulation conditions. Methods: To evaluate this contribution, we systematically assessed the role of clinical dialogues in triage performance using a balanced and stratified dataset of 1000 simulated Hajj-context scenarios. Results: The results demonstrate that incorporating clinical dialogues can significantly improve triage performance, with a 79.7% relative reduction in under-triage across all ESI levels. A more noticeable improvement was observed in high-acuity cases, with a 91.9% relative reduction in under-triage. In addition, the model achieved a high-acuity recall of 94.5%, highlighting its ability to identify critical "red-flag" symptoms that are often not captured in structured data. These findings suggest that narrative context may contribute to more accurate triage assessment and improved identification of high-acuity cases. Conclusions: Consequently, when evaluated within a controlled decision-support setting, this study suggests that large language model (LLM)-based systems may improve triage reliability and may contribute to safer triage decision-making in high-demand clinical environments.
zh_abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)]【背景/目的】在朝觐（Hajj）和副朝（Umrah）等大型聚集活动中，通过准确的急诊分诊优先保障患者安全至关重要，因为大量患者会显著增加临床差错的风险。尽管急诊严重程度指数（ESI）提供了标准化的分诊方案，但它仍依赖人的判断，而传统人工智能（AI）模型往往难以捕捉患者叙述中蕴含的细微临床背景。为弥补这一不足，本研究使用合成生成的对话评估GPT-5.2，作为迈向概念性临床决策支持框架的一步，该框架通过临床对话将结构化电子健康记录（EHR）与分诊交互联系起来。通过将叙述性输入与结构化生理指标相结合，探讨了在受控模拟条件下支持更明智临床决策的潜力。【方法】为评估这一贡献，我们使用包含1000个模拟朝觐情境的均衡分层数据集，系统评估了临床对话在分诊表现中的作用。【结果】结果表明，纳入临床对话可显著提高分诊表现，所有ESI级别的分诊不足相对减少79.7%。在高急症病例中改善更为明显，分诊不足相对减少91.9%。此外，模型的高急症召回率达到94.5%，凸显其识别结构化数据中常常无法捕捉的关键“危险信号”症状的能力。这些发现提示，叙述性背景可能有助于更准确的分诊评估，并改善对高急症病例的识别。【结论】因此，在受控的决策支持情境下评估，本研究提示基于大语言模型（LLM）的系统可能提高分诊可靠性，并可能有助于在高需求临床环境中做出更安全的分诊决策。

abstract: [Frontiers in oncology] Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly expanding across gynecologic oncology, but most applications remain focused on image interpretation and retrospective prediction rather than direct support of treatment decisions. This review examines how AI is progressing from imaging biomarkers toward multimodal decision-support systems that integrate radiologic, pathologic, molecular, and clinical information. We summarize current applications in ovarian, endometrial, and cervical cancers, with particular attention to preoperative risk stratification, surgical planning, radiotherapy, systemic treatment selection, treatment-response prediction, and multidisciplinary decision-making. Multimodal approaches are especially promising because they reflect the way clinical decisions are made and may provide greater value than models based on a single data source. However, the current evidence remains dominated by retrospective and often single-center studies, with limited external and prospective validation. Data heterogeneity, domain shift, incomplete multimodal datasets, bias, workflow integration, regulatory requirements, and model monitoring remain important barriers to routine implementation. We therefore outline a stepwise pathway for clinical translation, from robust multicenter validation and prospective human-AI evaluation to clinical-impact studies and post-deployment monitoring. The next phase of AI in gynecologic oncology should prioritize clinically meaningful decisions and measurable patient or workflow benefit rather than incremental gains in predictive performance alone.

abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] Cardiovascular diseases remain a leading cause of mortality and morbidity worldwide, highlighting the need for improved early detection, accurate diagnosis, and personalized therapeutic strategies. With advances in artificial intelligence (AI), Transformer-based models have attracted increasing interest because they can model long-range dependencies, support large-scale pre-training, and integrate heterogeneous data. Originally developed for natural language processing, Transformers have been extended to medical image analysis, physiological signal interpretation, and clinical text mining. abstract: Fibromyalgia (FM) lacks an objective biomarker, and blood transcriptomic signatures have been proposed to fill this gap. Here, the largest public peripheral blood mononuclear cell (PBMC) RNA-seq cohort of FM reporting expression subtypes (96 patients, 93 controls) was reanalysed using leakage-free nested cross-validation, with feature selection and scaling confined strictly to training folds. Gene expression discriminated patients from controls (ROC-AUC 0.821 for logistic regression and 0.825 for XGBoost), clearing a 100-repetition permutation-label null (p= 0.0099). Two simple, disease-agnostic baselines, however, reach nearly the same performance: sex alone reaches AUC 0.727, and a four-score PBMC cell-composition proxy reaches AUC 0.71-0.76. Restricting to females alone gives AUC 0.783 (0.705-0.858), and excluding X/Y-linked genes does not reduce performance, so the signal is not purely a sex-composition artifact; but the female-only expression model does not significantly exceed the composition-only proxy in the same females (0.783 vs. 0.712, paired 95% CI -0.025 to 0.175), so a composition contribution cannot be excluded. Preranked gene set enrichment analysis finds curated CLEAR/lysosomal and interferon/JAK-STAT gene sets, proxies for two subtype signatures of the original study, enriched among genes expressed lower in FM, also in females alone, but this enrichment disappears after adjusting for the composition proxies. Gynecological comorbidity, hormonal status, and medication are absent from the public metadata and remain plausible, untested contributors to the female-only estimate. These findings are hypothesis-generating, not a basis for clinical diagnosis: a single-cohort, correlational result consistent with, but not sufficient to establish, an FM-specific signal distinct from demographic, hormonal, and cell-composition confounds, pending independent replication. Future blood-based biomarker studies for FM, and for related nociplastic pain conditions such as endometriosis, should report performance relative to sex- and composition-based baselines as standard practice.
